title: instance-setup: consolidate its requirements under the cap, then answer its provider notices
prior_work: First, consolidate build/requirements/instance-setup.md (103340 bytes) under the requirements cap (70000): move non-requirement text (status history, rulings, cross-references, commentary) to docs/requirements-notes/instance-setup.md, which this job owns, and keep every **R<n>** and **F<n>** line and its mark verbatim; add a test under this module's tests that asserts the set of requirement ids and unmet marks in build/requirements/instance-setup.md is unchanged by the move (compare against the ids at the start commit). Then do the provider-notice work this START lists: for each notice, decide from your own requirements what this module must do, adapt or confirm, and add a test of your own for the change, failing with it reverted where code changes. Only if consolidation cannot get the file under the cap, stop and report to BOB with a split proposal (new module ids, build/modules.json rows, build/layers.md). Edit no other module, and commit no generated file (rows.mjs, words-unreviewed.json, any dist). Where build/situations/job.md names the old tool (proc), follow this START's commands instead.
